component.name: Accordion
component.description: Stacked disclosure list where only one panel is open at a time.

behavior.interaction: Clicking a trigger toggles its panel. Opening one item closes any other open item.
behavior.defaultOpen: defaultOpenId opens the matching item on initial render.
behavior.rendering: Panels render only when open (unmounted when closed).
behavior.animation: Icon rotates on open; no panel height animation.

states.default: all items closed unless defaultOpenId matches
states.open: single open item at a time
states.disabled: not supported (no disabled prop or styles)

responsiveness.rules: Responsive by container width; text wraps; no fixed breakpoints.

usageNotes: Provide concise titles; content can be any React node.
